prompt: Turn this flat diagram into a close-up texture photograph of the rough, weathered face of a grey granite boulder, two metres across. Keep the composition exactly: every shape stays where it is, at the same size and in the same colour family. Flat overcast diffuse daylight, no cast shadows, no specular highlights, uniform exposure from edge to edge, no perspective, no vignette, sharp focus everywhere. Photorealistic, high detail, natural muted colours of a cold, damp late-autumn borderland.
